# Roadmap: AI / LLM Engineer

## Role overview

Builds apps on top of large language models — chatbots, agents, RAG.

## Prerequisites

- [HTML](../topics/html.md)
- [Java](../topics/java.md)
- Usually 2+ years of experience when hired

## Learning stages

### Stage 1: Core skills

- [ ] [JavaScript](../topics/javascript.md)
- [ ] [Spring Boot](../topics/spring.md)

### Stage 2: Frameworks and depth

- [ ] [TypeScript](../topics/typescript.md)

## Also needed

Python, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, MCP SDKs, Vercel AI SDK, Claude / OpenAI / Gemini APIs, Vector DBs (pgvector, Pinecone), Langfuse / LangSmith

## Where it leads

Grow: AI Solutions Architect, Tech Lead · Lead: AI Product Manager, Engineering Manager · Pivot: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), AI Agent Engineer, AI Infrastructure / LLMOps Engineer
